The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.

Regarding the thematic structure of the provided text, the author’s motive is to explore the parallel between the natural cycle of life and decay and the fragility of human connection. By using the sunflower’s wilting as a botanical metaphor for the protagonist’s isolation and sadness, the author links the physical neglect of the plant to the emotional neglect of personal relationships. This structural choice reinforces the theme that just as plants require care to thrive, human bonds require attention to prevent decay, urging readers to reflect on the consequences of neglect in both domains.
